summary_1line: Indra sends the nymph Rambha to seduce Vishwamitra and break his austerities, but the sage perceives the plot and angrily curses her.

image_candidates.scene_text: The nymph Rambha in dazzling garments approaches the meditating sage Vishwamitra as a cuckoo sings from a blossoming tree where unseen Indra and Kama assist.
Vishwamitra opens his eyes in fury upon seeing Rambha before him while spring blossoms fall and the cuckoo calls in the background.
Rambha stands trembling with folded hands before Indra in heaven as he commands her to tempt the powerful sage.
